title: AIPAC PAC and United Democracy Project money, from their own FEC filings

committees.name: American Israel Public Affairs Committee PAC

notes: direct_total: AIPAC PAC contributions to the candidate's committee (FEC transaction types 24K/24Z).

earmarked_total: individual contributions AIPAC PAC collected and forwarded ('EARMARK OF ...'), from AIPAC PAC's own Schedule B (line 23 entries described 'EARMARK OF ...', including voids as reported), via api.open.fec.gov /schedules/schedule_b/, one row per transaction, latest amendment kept. Individual contributor names are not republished here.
ie_support_total / ie_oppose_total: United Democracy Project independent expenditures from FEC processed Schedule E data, one row per transaction (latest amendment kept).
udp_direct_total: United Democracy Project contributions to the candidate committee.
Voids and refunds are included as reported (negative amounts net against totals).
Recent 2026 activity may not yet appear until the FEC processes the latest reports.

unmatched.note: Entries whose FEC candidate ID could not be matched one-to-one from the filing; shown as filed, not resolved.
